canonical.definition: DURATECH is the ELIMFILTERS integrated filter-kit program for coordinated maintenance of a defined vehicle, truck, machine, equipment application, or service interval.
canonical.systems: Cross-system maintenance program. Kit contents depend on the approved application and may coordinate multiple ELIMFILTERS filtration systems.
canonical.related_technologies: DURATECH may incorporate products using canonical ELIMFILTERS technologies such as MACROCORE, MICROKAPPA, SYNTAPORE, HYDROCORE, SYNTRAX, NANOFORCE, THERMACORE, DRYCORE, or INTEKCORE where applicable to the validated kit definition. DURATECH itself is not a technology.
canonical.industrial_role: DURATECH simplifies coordinated filtration maintenance, inventory planning, recurring service execution, and asset-protection coverage for defined applications.
